contexts.text: By delight of the appetite... thus by external good.
They who are in external goods and truths constitute the rest of the viscera and members in the Grand Man.
The tranquillity of peace with external goods and truths at the same time. Signified. An ox = external good.
Brass = external good... External good is the good of the external or natural man.
The external good of the Most Ancient Church. Signified.
The external truths and goods by which they are held together. Signified.
The plenary capacity of conjunction from external good. Signified.
